capabilities: Preview chapter files, filenames and source scene paths from a Longform index
Join scene text into chapter files, stripping initial frontmatter
Write a linked export index tracing chapters back to source scenes
Select chapter ranges and heading/filename formats (Pro)
disambiguation: It does not convert to PDF, DOCX or LaTeX and does not run Pandoc; it only writes Markdown chapter files from a Longform project.
extras: Freemium: free tier covers preview and full export; Pro (chapter ranges, custom formats, presets) requires a GitHub Sponsors sponsorship ($5/month or $15 once) with GitHub device-flow sign-in. After updates the plugin opens a What's new tab promoting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat. The README states mobile, Windows, Linux and large-manuscript performance were untested.
intentEvidence: Chapter Batch Export saves a Longform manuscript as separate Markdown chapter files.
problem: Longform keeps a manuscript as scenes under one index, so writers lack separate per-chapter Markdown files to feed into a later document conversion step.

relations.evidence: Chapter Batch Export saves a Longform manuscript as separate Markdown chapter files.

summary: Longform manuscript exporter that saves each chapter as separate Markdown files in the vault, with a preview and a linked export index.
